head: Google and Samsung AI glasses with Gemini go on pre-order from $395
dek: Google and Samsung's Intelligent Eyewear smart glasses, with Gemini built in, are on pre-order in frames from Warby Parker starting at $395 and from Gentle Monster starting at $449.
details: Gentle Monster offers six designs in several colors with tinted, clear, blue or brown lenses. Warby Parker has three styles, Alden, Reid and Wren, as optical or sun glasses. Both take prescription lenses. They compete with Meta's Ray-Ban glasses.
where: Pre-order, Warby Parker and Gentle Monster
means: Gemini on your face is now something you can order, at a lower starting price than Meta's newest Ray-Bans.
todo: If you wear glasses, check that your prescription can be fitted before you pre-order.
